camera_views: Supported camera views (e.g., side, front, diagonal)
input.max_people: Maximum number of people allowed in frame

selected_landmarks: List of landmarks extracted and used in analysis
tracking_landmarks: Main keypoints tracked for primary movement analysis

movement.movement_plane: Anatomical plane of movement (Sagittal / Frontal / Transverse)
movement.movement_direction: Primary direction of motion (Vertical, Horizontal, etc.)

features.joint_angles: Whether joint angle calculation is required (true/false)
features.velocity: Whether linear velocity calculation is required (true/false)
features.acceleration: Whether linear acceleration calculation is required (true/false)
features.angular_velocity: Whether angular velocity calculation is required (true/false)
features.angular_acceleration: Whether angular acceleration calculation is required (true/false)
features.rom: Whether Range of Motion analysis is required (true/false)
features.stability: Whether center of mass or body stability analysis is required (true/false)
features.symmetry: Whether body symmetry comparison is required (true/false)
features.trajectory: Whether spatial movement trajectory tracking is required (true/false)

possible_errors: List of all detectable form and technique errors
phase_classes: List of target phase classification labels
pass_fail_classes: Overall evaluation output classes (e.g., pass, fail)

phase_reference.phase_metric_name: Threshold value used to trigger phase transition
